findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container
findings.comment:
Observed home made cookies in plastic bags for sale at counter with no label. Advised PIC to place a label with ingredients and allergens on each package, or place a placard at point of sale.

3-601.11: PACKAGED FOOD shall comply with standard of identity requirements in 21 CFR 131-169 and 9 CFR 319 Definitions and standards of identity or composition, and the general requirements in 21 CFR 130  Food Standards: General and 9 CFR 319 Subpart A  General.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: 5-205.11: (A) Observed metal rods stored up against faucet and handles of hand washing sink in kitchen. Rods were removed during inspection.  A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-602.11: (D) Observed interior of ice machine to be soiled with debris. Clean and sanitize interior of ice machine. FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.16: Observed wet mop head to be stored head down in mop bucket. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. P (C) PACKAGED Food shall be properly labeled. (E) WHOLE-MUSCLE BEEF shall be from approved source and acceptable from AUTHROITY. Pf (D) FISH must be frozen if consumed undercooked. (F) Meat and Poultry shall be properly labeled. (G) Eggs shall be properly labeled. C
Observed a crock insert with cooled cheese sauce in the bottom portion of the prep table. This cheese sauce was discarded in the garbage. Facility was counseled on the food preparation activities allowed under a medium risk permit. The cooling activity has taken place just since the cheese machine began to malfunction. findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

New wall placed behind mop sink in utility room is bare exposed wood. Discussed with PIC, place a layer of paint or stain to render the wall smooth and easily cleanable, prevent moisture from seeping into wall.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-207.12: (A) Medicine belonging to EMPLOYEES shall be: (A) Stored in package covered, leak-proof, and identifiable. (B) Inaccessible to children.

Observed a vial of insulin stored on top shelf of cooler, above condiments and other food items for facility use. Discussed with PIC. Ensure staff who have temperature sensitive medication use the refrigerator in the office to store medication to prevent accidental contamination of customer food. Dry employee medications should be stored in a designated employee personal items space. COS-PIC removed insulin and placed in office fridge.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Single use containers are stored on the back cabinet area at birthday uncovered with the food contact surface exposed to the air (up). Dispose of top container and close plastic bag or invert on clean surface.  Handle single use items properly.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.citation_text:
750.151 - Ready to eat potentially hazardous foods (hotdogs, pepperoni, & sausage) in the pizza cooler had date marks indicating they were beyond the 7 day time frame for use. Dates of 8/10, 8/20, and 6/1 were observed on products. All products are received frozen, portioned frozen, and then pulled from the freezer when needed. A few portions of foods were dated 8/27, one of which was a bag of pepperoni in the bottom of the cooler that clearly had 8/27 written over the original portion date of 6/1. Benefit of doubt was given for all products. Foods were dated 8/27 and kept to be used by the end of operations on 9/2.

Refrigerated PHF shall be clearly dated and sold, consumed, or discarded w/in 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.
**Make sure dates are documented and tracked accordingly based on when foods are pulled from the freezer and thawed for use. Since all foods come in frozen, the 7 day time frame would start for foods once they are thawed and being held in the pizza cooler.**

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.citation_text:
750.151 - Ready to eat potentially hazardous foods (PHF) were observed with date marks indicating they were past the 7 day time frame for use. Hotdogs in the bottom holding area of the pizza cooler were dated 10/14. Bags of pepperoni and sausage in the top holding area of the pizza cooler had dates of 9/9 and 10/7 respectively. Employee stated the products arrive frozen, are portioned frozen, and are not pulled/placed in the cooler until they are ready to be used. Employee stated the products were more than likely pulled from the freezer on 10/25 when cooler was restocked. Pans of cheese and other foods had 10/25 date mark. Benefit of the doubt was given; pepperoni, sausage, and hotdogs were dated (10/25) and kept for use. All foods will be used or discarded before the end of the business day on 10/31.
 
Refrigerated PHF shall be clearly dated and sold, consumed, or discarded w/in 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.
**Make sure dates are documented and tracked accordingly based on when foods are pulled from the freezer and thawed for use. Since all foods come in frozen, the 7 day time frame would start for foods once they are thawed and being held in the pizza cooler.**

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.citation_text:
750.280 - Plastic cup was observed inside bulk sugar used for slushi mix. Cup was removed. Use a scoop with a handle (i.e. measuring cup) when dispensing sugar.

Ready to eat foods shall be handled in a manner to minimize direct hand contact. When handling ready to eat foods use suitable utensils (gloves, tongs, scoops, etc.).

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - (R) Mold was observed on the white baffle inside the ice machine. Some buildup was also observed on the walls adjacent to the baffle.

Clean and sanitize inside the ice machine as needed to eliminate buildup of mold.

findings.title: Cross-contamination, equipment, personnel, storage
findings.citation_text:
750.120 - Soda nozzles/diffusers at food counter had mold buildup. The heaviest mold buildup was observed on the Fruit Punch and Mt. Dew nozzles/diffusers. All nozzles/diffusers were removed from the soda machine and placed at 3 part sink to soak prior to being placed through ware washing process.

Food and equipment must be protected from cross contamination at all times. Clean and sanitize soda nozzles/diffusers as needed to eliminate mold buildup and prevent cross contamination. **NOTE: Nozzles/diffusers at soda machine in party area had some sticky splash buildup but did not have mold accumulation. Staff noted nozzles/diffusers for both soda machines would be added to routine cleaning schedule.**

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g - Quat test kit was not available at the facility. Staff noted the set of test strips they had got water damage and had to be discarded. Owner arrived during the inspection with more test strips.

A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.
NOTE: If bleach is used for sanitizing food or non-food contact surfaces then a chlorine test kit needs to be maintained on-site as well.**

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.citation_text: 750.151 - Bags of pepperoni in top holding area of pizza cooler had 6-12 as the date on storage bag. Plastic storage container with hotdogs inside was not labeled in the bottom holding area of the pizza cooler. Pepperoni comes in frozen and is pulled for use as needed. Benefit of doubt was given and proper date was placed on the pepperoni. Hotdogs were voluntarily discarded by the Owner. Owner and employee were advised on proper date marking and changing dates on products once pulled from the freezer to be thawed and used. Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held shall be clearly dated and consumed, sold, or discarded w/in 7days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.citation_text: 750.160 & 280 - Plastic soufflé cup was observed inside container with pretzel salt. Soufflé cup was discarded by employee during the inspection. Ready to eat foods shall be handled in a manner to minimize direct hand contact. Use suitable utensils when handling ready to eat foods (gloves, tongs, scoop, deli tissue, etc.).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text:
750.690 - A) Both ice cream freezers had ice buildup inside, and the small white freezer had a section where paint has peeled off/rust was present on the top outside of the lid. Defrost the ice cream freezers. Repaint the outer surface of the white freezer lid. Clean the seal around the top of the large Kemps freezer as needed to eliminate buildup of debris. B) Lid to plastic storage tub was cracked on nacho chip storage tub. Replace the cracked lid. C) Handsink counter in men's room and handsink by 3 part sink were not properly sealed to the wall. Caulk the aforementioned counter and sink to their adjoining walls.
Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: 750.830g - Quat test strips were not present at the facility. Owner stated they were on an incoming order that should be received before the facility opens for business this evening. Obtain and use test strips for checking sanitizer concentrations. A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizers that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. Follow label instructions for mixing quat solutions from concentrate, and use test strips to verify proper concentration.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) food compartment of PFA Rapid Fryer (grease/crumbs); B) soda nozzles/diffusers (buildup); & C) drip guard inside ice machine (mold). Clean and sanitize soda nozzles/diffusers and inside the ice machine as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of mold. **In-use utensils (i.e. pizza slicer, knives, etc) must be cleaned/sanitized up to every 4hrs when facility is operating/serving food**

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) general surfaces (rollers, side cover, etc.) of pizza oven (dust/crumbs) ; B) bottom inside pizza cooler (food debris); C) seal around Kemps ice cream freezer sliding doors (buildup); D) general surfaces inside PFA Rapid fryer (grease/food debris); & E) bottom inside plastic tubs for storage of bagged nacho chips and plastic nacho boats. Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text: 750.860 - A) Clean metal pizza trays were observed on counter below pizza oven. Counter under the oven was soiled with dust. Discussed a different storage location for pizza trays and/or cleaning/sanitizing counter and underside of pizza oven at frequent intervals to protect clean trays from potential contamination. B) Clean utensils were observed in pans with moist wiping cloths in the top holding area of the pizza cooler. Discussed better storage options for utensils and ways to maintain containers so condensation is less of an issue. C) Clean serving utensils were observed with food surfaces extended up out of storage container next to soda machine at the side drink counter by the skate rink. Store clean utensils with food surfaces down and handles extended up out of storage containers. Maintain storage areas for cleaned/sanitized utensils/equipment so items are protected from potential contamination.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text:
750.1170 - New set of outer doors on west side of skate rink had a gap at the bottom where light was visible, and a writing pen fit through the gap to the outside of the building. Owner's son installed and replaced weather stripping at the east and west skate rink outer doors as well as the middle set of front entrance doors during the inspection. Monitor outer openings and replace weather stripping/door sweeps as needed to maintain doors tight fitting and vermin proof. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.
**Owner plans to contact the company that installed the doors on the west side of the rink to come back and make proper commercial grade repairs to the door.**

Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Maintain proper labels on all spray bottles.
